label: ACCOMPLISHED_COGNITIVE_CORRECTION_2: A change that actually replaces an erroneous judgment by a…
definition: A change that actually replaces an erroneous judgment by a correct one. No result in the explanation-order test asserts this stronger temporal claim.
note: Analyst contrast sense, attribution deferred. The shared temporal/error/correctness/withdrawal conditions are implemented in TruthCore.Logic.CognitiveReplacement.ReplacementConditions, but this is not yet a binding of the original sense. OPEN semantic scope: does replacement require the same subject revising the same matter, or may an explicit replacement link relate judgments on different matters? Same content cannot mean identical judgment: correction may reverse a verdict on that content. The common core uses actual endorsement at strictly ordered occasions, erroneous-before/correct-after under a supplied correctness norm, withdrawal of the old judgment, and an explicit replacement link. A later correct belief alone, retention of the erroneous endorsement, or a free replacement flag alone does not suffice. Correctness, actual-history applicability and the replacement link remain explicit semantic inputs; no report agreement, external warrant, factivity, authority or source instance follows. Owner selected both scopes as interpretation siblings CORRECTION_3 and CORRECTION_4, not a choice of original binding. Keep CORRECTION_2 unresolved: a faithful original mapping and the independent meaning of cross-matter replacement remain open. The root connection plan is the existing reason/truth obligations via a separately justified genuine-moral-correction bridge (418606fa-bf33-5996-882e-5eebbe88ab22); neither that bridge nor need-to-accomplishment is asserted here. Explicit root target: STMT-CATHOLICISM-TRUE (53964cbe-5831-5812-af33-4d87896d47a7), specifically its teaching/truth obligation. The missing bridge would have to connect an actual correction history under its supplied judgment norm to the truth of the particular teaching, and then to the universal teaching-authority claim. Neither generic correction nor the unused moral-correction bridge supplies that warrant. This is a connection plan with an open applicability/authority blocker, not connected progress on the case.
